'''''Cyperus luzulae''''' is a species of [[Cyperus|sedge]] that is native to parts of southern parts of [[North America]], most of [[Central America]] and northern parts of [[South America]].<ref name=kew>{{cite web|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:74851-2|title=''Cyperus luzulae'' (L.) Retz.|access-date=14 April 2022|publisher=Kew Science – Plants of the World Online}}</ref>
